issue.title: Issue finding age in months from participants.tsv for v24.0.0

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the participants.tsv age bug, but found a regression: the existing test nibabies/utils/tests/test_bids.py::test_get_age_from_tsv[session_id-x1-data0-False-None] passed before the fix and fails after it, and the reproduced bug is not guarded by a test that fails without the fix. Look first at why that test case now fails, and then at the behaviour changes in age_to_months,…

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: Matches the PR-added docstring example `age_to_months(0.5, 'years')` -> 6 and the `-> int` return annotation.

labels.label: suspicious
labels.reason: A months value needs no conversion, yet 0.5 is now rounded down to 0 by half-even rounding; neither the issue nor the docstring asks to round months input.

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: Returning int 0 instead of -0.0 follows the documented `-> int` return type.

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: Same rounding-to-int rule as the added docstring example (0.5 years -> 6), applied to another fractional year.

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: Follows the `-> int` annotation and the rounding behaviour the docstring examples show.

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: An int result follows the `-> int` annotation; the value is the rounded equivalent of the old result.

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: A tiny fractional age rounds to 0, consistent with the docstring rounding examples and the `-> int` contract.

labels.label: suspicious
labels.reason: Neither the issue nor the docstring asks for a new OverflowError on overflowing input; the crash is a side effect of int(round()).

labels.label: suspicious
labels.reason: Nothing written asks for an infinite age to raise OverflowError; this is a new crash not covered by the issue or the docstring.

labels.label: suspicious
labels.reason: Nothing written asks for NaN to raise; a NaN age (e.g. an n/a cell in participants.tsv) can now reach age_to_months and crash the pipeline instead of yielding no age, which goes beyond the issue.
